name: Art Deco
summary: The luxury room of the machine age. Symmetric plans, stepped and fan geometry, black lacquer, exotic veneers and polished chrome or brass give high contrast; a mirror or a mural on the axis and cove light in the ceiling make the room a stage.

philosophy.core_thesis: Luxury and the machine meet in one bold geometric order of rare materials and high contrast.
design_principles: Compose the room on a strong central axis with a focal mirror, mural or fireplace at its end.
Use stepped, zigzag, sunburst and fan forms in mouldings, furniture and metalwork.
Pair a dark ground with light accents at high contrast: black lacquer with ivory, chrome or gold.
Use rare veneers, shagreen, lacquer and inlay on large, simple furniture shapes.
Hide the light in ceiling coves and behind frosted glass panels.
Repeat one geometric motif at three scales: the floor, the furniture and the hardware.
anti_patterns: Soft pastel colour schemes with no contrast

composition.plan_logic: A symmetric plan on one main axis. A stepped ceiling cove and a geometric floor inlay mark the centre; furniture stands in mirrored pairs.
composition.focal_point: A stepped fireplace or a large mirror with a sunburst frame on the centre of the back wall.

rules.rule: Mirror the room about one main axis that ends at the focal wall.
Set dark lacquer and veneer against ivory, chrome or gilt.
Repeat stepped and fan motifs in the cornice, the floor inlay and the hardware.
Give the focal wall the richest material; the side walls stay plain.
End the axis on a mirror, a mural or a stepped fireplace.
Use low, broad, heavy pieces with large flat surfaces of veneer.
Repeat one geometric motif at 3 scales.
Give a dark or ivory ground the main share, veneer the second, and metal and one jewel colour the accents.
Hide the ambient light in a stepped ceiling cove and use frosted glass for the decorative layer.
Keep the main axis clear from the door to the focal wall.
Shoot the room level, with a frontal view on the axis, verticals parallel.

zoning.circulation: One straight central route on the axis; secondary routes run behind the paired chairs.

palette.distribution: Black or ivory lacquer on the large surfaces; macassar ebony or walnut veneer on furniture; chrome, gold and one jewel colour such as jade or coral in the accents.

lighting.strategy: Hidden, even ambient light in ceiling coves; frosted glass fittings in geometric forms; reflections from lacquer, mirror and metal.
lighting.daylight: Tall windows with simple straight curtains; the mirror on the axis doubles the daylight.

layers.source: LED strip in a stepped ceiling cove
frosted glass and chrome ceiling fitting in tiers
frosted glass wall sconces in fan or shell forms
chrome table lamp with a glass shade
layers.position: on side tables and the desk

materials.finish: High-gloss lacquer, polished veneer and metal, mirror.
materials.texture_contrast: High gloss against velvet and shagreen, at about 2:1 in favour of gloss.

furniture.silhouette: Low, massive, simple shapes with rounded or stepped corners, tapered feet and inlaid lines.
furniture.arrangement: Mirrored pairs of armchairs and side tables on the main axis around a low table.

textiles.pattern: Bold geometric repeats: chevron, fan, sunburst; plain velvet on the furniture.
textiles.windows: Straight floor-length satin curtains on a concealed track, with a geometric pelmet.

objects.approach: A few sculptural objects in rare materials, placed in pairs on the axis.

implementation.brief: A symmetric salon with black lacquer walls, an ivory stepped ceiling cove and a marble floor with a brass inlay. A sunburst mirror over a stepped fireplace ends the axis; two ivory velvet club chairs and a macassar ebony cocktail cabinet stand in mirrored pairs.
implementation.image_prompt: Art Deco salon, symmetrical, black lacquer walls, ivory stepped ceiling with hidden cove light, sunburst mirror above a stepped marble fireplace on the central axis, pair of ivory velvet club armchairs, macassar ebony cocktail cabinet with brass inlay, chrome and frosted glass wall sconces in fan form, marble floor with geometric brass inlay, high contrast, glamorous, 1920s Paris, interior photograph
implementation.negative_prompt: Rustic, distressed, pastel, asymmetric, bare bulbs, plant curves, clutter.
implementation.camera: 24 mm lens at 140 cm, frontal view on the axis, verticals parallel.
implementation.scene_3d: Room 700 x 500 cm, ceiling 320 cm with a 30 cm stepped cove. 2700 K strip in the cove; two 2400 K sconces at 170 cm; glossy materials with roughness 0.1.
furniture_list: 2 club chairs 85 x 90 x 75 cm, seat 42 cm

emotion.target_response: Glamour: the viewer feels on a stage, in a room of luxury, speed and confidence.

avoid_when: The brief asks for a rustic or soft family room.
The budget does not allow lacquer, veneer and metal of quality.

modifiers.how: Add lacquer colour, bold stripes, white plaster and gilt mirrors; keep the symmetry and the high contrast.
Round the forms, soften the contrast, add curved bouclé seats, fluted wood and a warm terracotta or green.

canonical_works.work: Hôtel du Collectionneur, Exposition des Arts Décoratifs

sources.title: Charlotte Benton, Tim Benton and Ghislaine Wood (eds), Art Deco 1910–1939 (V&A Publications, 2003)
Alastair Duncan, Art Deco Furniture (Thames and Hudson, 1984)
